files.README.md:
# parcel-trail

Parcel tracking for the regional courier: depot scans in, tracking page and recipient messages out.

files.docs/architecture.md:
# Architecture

## Scan ingestion
Depot scanners upload CSV batches every five minutes instead of streaming single events. Rural depots lose connectivity several times a day, and a batch survives a dropped link: it is replayed whole on reconnect.

## Storage
Parcel statuses live in SQLite, one row per scan. Postgres can wait until partners query us directly.

events.title: M1 Tracking core
events.what: Ingest depot scans and let recipients look up a parcel by its tracking code.

events.ref: chat 2026-03-02: scan ingestion, status store, public lookup and two caches

events.message: feat(scan): parse depot scanner CSV batches
feat(scan): validate barcodes and replay whole batches

events.why: Transitions are whitelisted so a late scan cannot move a delivered parcel back to in transit.

events.title: Fix timezone in scan timestamps
events.what: Scanners send local depot time, so the tracking page shows deliveries an hour off.

events.message: fix(scan): convert depot local time to UTC
feat(lookup): hide recipient name on public page
feat(cache): cache parcel lookups for 30 seconds
events.why: Lookups spike right after out-for-delivery messages go out, and 30 seconds stays well under the five-minute scanner upload interval.

events.message: feat(cache): load depot list at boot, refresh nightly
events.why: The depot list only changes when a depot opens or closes, so it is loaded once at boot and refreshed nightly.

events.title: M2 Recipient notifications
events.what: Tell recipients and partners when a parcel changes status.

events.message: feat(webhook): emit status changes to partner URLs

events.title: M3 Partner integrations
events.what: Give partner shops keys, exports and limits so they can track their own parcels.

events.why: Partner endpoints go down during their nightly deploys, so failed calls are retried with exponential backoff for up to six hours.

events.title: Drop duplicate scan rows
events.what: A depot replaying the same batch twice creates duplicate status rows and double webhooks.

events.message: feat(webhook): exponential backoff capped at six hours
feat(sms): send out-for-delivery text via regional gateway

events.ref: chat 2026-03-24: send out-for-delivery messages on WhatsApp instead of SMS

events.why: The regional SMS gateway bills per segment and most recipients already read WhatsApp, so out-for-delivery messages move to a WhatsApp template.

events.message: feat(whatsapp): send template through business API

events.message: feat(cache): evict parcel lookup on new scan
events.why: A new scan must evict the cached lookup at once so the tracking page never shows a parcel as in transit after it was delivered.

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix: { node: [20, 22] }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '${{ matrix.node }}' }
      - run: npm ci && npm test
